CONSTRUCTOR_MK1.name: Constructor
CONSTRUCTOR_MK1.description: Designed for mobile construction and refitting. Inter-system travel.

SHIPYARD_MK1.name: Shipyard
SHIPYARD_MK1.description: Designed for stationary construction. Stationary installation.

REPAIR_SHIP_SMALL.name: Small Repair Ship
REPAIR_SHIP_SMALL.description: Designed for local repair. Intra-system travel only.

REPAIR_STATION_SMALL.name: Small Repair Station
REPAIR_STATION_SMALL.description: Designed for stationary repair. Stationary installation.

MINING_SHIP_SMALL.name: Small Mining Ship
MINING_SHIP_SMALL.description: Designed for local mining. Intra-system travel only. Mine metal asteroids or comets and unload at the matching refinery.

ANTIMATTER_HARVESTER.name: Antimatter Harvester
ANTIMATTER_HARVESTER.description: Designed for fuel collection. Inter-system travel. Harvest near stars or inside hydrogen nebulae.

TRADE_FREIGHTER_MK1.name: Trade Freighter
TRADE_FREIGHTER_MK1.description: Designed for local trade. Intra-system travel only. Needs active habitats in different sectors.

METAL_REFINERY_STATION.name: Metal Refinery Station
METAL_REFINERY_STATION.description: Designed for metal refining. Stationary installation.

CRYSTAL_REFINERY_STATION.name: Crystal Refinery Station
CRYSTAL_REFINERY_STATION.description: Designed for crystal refining. Stationary installation.

HANGAR_SHIP_LARGE.name: Utility Transport
HANGAR_SHIP_LARGE.description: Designed for Tiny vessel transport. Inter-system travel. Hangar accepts Tiny vessels, not strikecraft wings.

MISSILE_PLATFORM.name: Missile Platform
MISSILE_PLATFORM.description: Designed for local missile defense. Stationary installation.

FIGHTER_WING.name: Fighter Wing
FIGHTER_WING.description: Designed for fighter screen. Built and replenished in a strikecraft bay; requires a carrier for transport between sectors.

BOMBER_WING.name: Bomber Wing
BOMBER_WING.description: Designed for bomber strike. Built and replenished in a strikecraft bay; requires a carrier for transport between sectors.

PATROL_CUTTER.name: Patrol Cutter
PATROL_CUTTER.description: Designed for local patrol. Local-sector operations; Tiny craft can travel aboard a hangar transport.

INTERCEPTOR.name: Interceptor
INTERCEPTOR.description: Designed for strikecraft interception. Inter-system travel.

KINETIC_FRIGATE.name: Kinetic Frigate
KINETIC_FRIGATE.description: Designed for kinetic combat. Inter-system travel.

BEAM_FRIGATE.name: Beam Frigate
BEAM_FRIGATE.description: Designed for beam combat. Inter-system travel.

MISSILE_FRIGATE.name: Missile Frigate
MISSILE_FRIGATE.description: Designed for missile combat. Inter-system travel.

FLAK_ESCORT.name: Flak Escort
FLAK_ESCORT.description: Designed for fleet air defense. Inter-system travel.

ARTILLERY_CRUISER.name: Artillery Cruiser
ARTILLERY_CRUISER.description: Designed for ranged fire support. Inter-system travel.

ASSAULT_CRUISER.name: Assault Cruiser
ASSAULT_CRUISER.description: Designed for direct assault. Inter-system travel.

BATTLESHIP.name: Battleship
BATTLESHIP.description: Designed for fleet anchor. Inter-system travel.

SIEGE_DREADNOUGHT.name: Siege Dreadnought
SIEGE_DREADNOUGHT.description: Designed for siege bombardment. Inter-system travel.

ESCORT_CARRIER.name: Escort Carrier
ESCORT_CARRIER.description: Designed for light carrier. Inter-system travel. Build fighter or bomber wings using the production selector.

FLEET_CARRIER.name: Fleet Carrier
FLEET_CARRIER.description: Designed for carrier command. Inter-system travel. Build fighter or bomber wings using the production selector.

SENSOR_STATION.name: Sensor Station
SENSOR_STATION.description: Designed for long-range reconnaissance. Stationary installation.

BOARDING_CRUISER.name: Boarding Cruiser
BOARDING_CRUISER.description: Designed for boarding and capture. Inter-system travel.

INTERDICTOR.name: Interdictor
INTERDICTOR.description: Designed for mobile jump denial. Inter-system travel. Activate clear of existing natural or artificial inhibition fields; maintain fuel supply.

MINELAYER.name: Minelayer
MINELAYER.description: Designed for mine deployment. Inter-system travel.

MINESWEEPER.name: Minesweeper
MINESWEEPER.description: Designed for mine detection and clearance. Inter-system travel.

INTELLIGENCE_SHIP.name: Intelligence Ship
INTELLIGENCE_SHIP.description: Designed for espionage and counter-intelligence. Inter-system travel.

STEALTH_TENDER.name: Stealth Tender
STEALTH_TENDER.description: Designed for fleet concealment and decoys. Inter-system travel.

COMMAND_CRUISER.name: Command Cruiser
COMMAND_CRUISER.description: Designed for target designation and protection. Inter-system travel.

NEBULA_TENDER.name: Nebula Tender
NEBULA_TENDER.description: Designed for nebula and fuel support. Inter-system travel. Harvest near stars or inside hydrogen nebulae.

RAIDER.name: Raider
RAIDER.description: Designed for covert raiding. Inter-system travel.

EXPEDITION_MINER.name: Expedition Miner
EXPEDITION_MINER.description: Designed for expedition mining. Inter-system travel. Mine metal asteroids or comets and unload at the matching refinery.

FLEET_TANKER.name: Fleet Tanker
FLEET_TANKER.description: Designed for fleet resupply. Inter-system travel. Harvest near stars or inside hydrogen nebulae.

BLOCKADE_RUNNER.name: Blockade Runner
BLOCKADE_RUNNER.description: Designed for covert inter-system trade. Inter-system travel. Needs active habitats in different sectors.

FLEET_REPAIR_SHIP.name: Fleet Repair Ship
FLEET_REPAIR_SHIP.description: Designed for fleet repair. Inter-system travel.

HEAVY_SHIPYARD.name: Heavy Shipyard
HEAVY_SHIPYARD.description: Designed for construction and repair base. Stationary installation. Hangar accepts Tiny vessels, not strikecraft wings. Support facilities do not accelerate construction.

INDUSTRIAL_HUB.name: Industrial Hub
INDUSTRIAL_HUB.description: Designed for industrial support. Stationary installation.

CIVILIAN_HABITAT.name: Civilian Habitat
CIVILIAN_HABITAT.description: Designed for income and trade destination. Stationary installation. Requires a friendly or allied colony and an available colony support slot.

FUEL_DEPOT.name: Fuel Depot
FUEL_DEPOT.description: Designed for stationary fuel collection. Stationary installation. Harvest near stars or inside hydrogen nebulae.

FLAK_BATTERY.name: Flak Battery
FLAK_BATTERY.description: Designed for stationary air defense. Stationary installation.

ORBITAL_BASTION.name: Orbital Bastion
ORBITAL_BASTION.description: Designed for colony defense. Stationary installation. Requires a friendly or allied colony and an available colony support slot.

INTERDICTION_FORTRESS.name: Interdiction Fortress
INTERDICTION_FORTRESS.description: Designed for fortified jump denial. Stationary installation. Activate clear of existing natural or artificial inhibition fields; maintain fuel supply.

MINING_DRONE.name: Mining Drone
MINING_DRONE.description: Designed for transportable mining. Local-sector operations; Tiny craft can travel aboard a hangar transport. Mine metal asteroids or comets and unload at the matching refinery.

PATROL_ESCORT.name: Patrol Escort
PATROL_ESCORT.description: Economical armed escort for patrol and convoy protection. Inter-system travel.

COVERT_INTELLIGENCE_SHIP.name: Covert Intelligence Ship
COVERT_INTELLIGENCE_SHIP.description: Externally identical to the Patrol Escort, with two hidden intelligence agents. Constructed under the cover name ‘Patrol Escort’. After construction, you may rename it to another generic warship name; avoid names that reveal its intelligence role. Inter-system travel.
